shared_elements: low-relief carving on a large upright rectangular stone slab/monolith
figural or zoomorphic motif rendered in raised relief on a flat vertical face
justification: Both surfaces are flat vertical faces of upright rectangular blocks bearing shallow raised-outline relief, and both include sinuous curvilinear elements, but that is a generic shared format rather than a shared motif. A shows abstract meandering bands and a small quadruped/reptile in profile on a lateral face, while B is dominated by a single large frontal anthropomorphic figure with headdress-like superstructure and small sign-like elements along the base — different subjects in different compositional logic.
